potato_early_blight.symptoms: Brown to black spots on older lower leaves with concentric dark rings resembling a target board. Leaf tissue yellows around spots.

organic_measures.name: Bordeaux Mixture / Copper Hydroxide
organic_measures.method: Spray 1% Bordeaux mixture or copper hydroxide (2 g/L) at early detection.

organic_measures.name: Debris Removal
organic_measures.method: Remove and safely destroy heavily infected haulms/vines.

prevention_measures: Rotate fields away from solanaceous crops for 3 years.
Ensure optimal nitrogen and potassium fertilization to prevent early senescence.
Maintain hill height to protect tubers from spore wash-in.
sources: ICAR-Central Potato Research Institute (CPRI) Disease Advisory

potato_late_blight.symptoms: Dark brown water-soaked lesions expanding rapidly across leaves and stems with white mold fringe on underside during damp conditions.

organic_measures.name: Fixed Copper Fungicide
organic_measures.method: Apply copper oxychloride (3 g/L) before blight spreads across field canopy.
organic_measures.frequency: Every 5 days in cool wet weather

chemical_measures.name: Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP
chemical_measures.safety_precautions: Wear full PPE. Systemic protectant. Comply with strict harvest withdrawal intervals.

prevention_measures: Destroy cull piles before season start.
Kill haulms (de-haulming) 10-14 days before harvest to protect tubers.

potato_healthy.symptoms: Sturdy green stems, lush foliage without blemishes, regular tuberization.

organic_measures.name: Organic Soil Vigor Management
organic_measures.method: Ensure proper earthing up and balanced organic compost / biofertilizer application.

prevention_measures: Monitor fields routinely for aphids and early blight symptoms.
